en.html:
...And like that, our ordinary Sunday, with nothing remarkable about it, came to an end.

In the same bed, I lay beside that warmth.

en.html:
A quiet place. Bol diya. As though I had one folded up somewhere, ready for us.

Before the words left my mouth, I knew how empty they were. No such place was there. Land without fighting—where? Nowhere.

Run away, then run again. Go on running. That would probably be our journey, looking for a place that did not exist.

Toh kya? Even if that was how it had to be—

Enough fighting for this man.

He should forget it now. Forget fighting, and live.

ja.html:
その言葉の空疎さは、口に出す前から知っていた。

　静かな場所なんてない。
　争いのない土地なんて、何処にも。

　ありもしないものを求めるなら――
　それは逃げて、ただ逃げ続けるだけの旅路になるの
だろう。

　しかし、例えそうなったとしても、
　
　――この人はもう、戦うべきではない。

　戦いを忘れて生きるべきだ。

en.html:
This much I knew for certain. Trouble was, that certainty had come to hurt me.

What was the one thing that would not let Kageaki Minato forget fighting?

A weapon.
A tsurugi.

Myself only. Muramasa, right here.

I wanted him to forget fighting. While I stayed beside him, how would he forget? Those memories, how would they leave him?

In the daytime I had told him: no other path had I wanted, and becoming a tsurugi I did not regret.

A lie I had not told him.
But now...

ja.html:
その確信。
　その確信は、一つの苦悶を呼ぶ。

　湊斗景明という人に、戦いを忘れさせない決定的な
要因があるとすれば、それは何か。

　武器だ。
　劒冑だ。

　ここにいる<ruby>村正<rt>わたし</rt></ruby>だ。

　私と一緒にいる限り、彼は戦いを、過去の記憶を、
決して忘れ去れないだろう。

　――昼間の会話。
　劒冑になる以外の道を望まなかったし、後悔もして
いないと言った。

　それは本当のこと。
　けれど、今は……

Let me become something else.
Kuch aur. Not a tsurugi.

Not iron. Not a blade.

Something that could hold this man beside me...
without sorrow coming to lie between us also.
